bio.text: Ben Fuhriman represents Idaho House District 30, Seat B, and lists a Shelley, Idaho address; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a first term and a business owner and financial advisor occupation.

The legislature biography says Fuhriman was born and raised in Ammon, Idaho, has a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University-Idaho and a master's degree in family financial planning from Montana State University.
The biography lists ownership of an independent financial planning firm in Idaho Falls and service on the board of the Grand Teton Council of the Boy Scouts of America.
